t: You're on Wandsworth Common, a public common of about sixty-nine hectares in south London, looked after by Wandsworth Council. The area is also a ward of the borough. Several people with a link to the common are known. The chef Gordon Ramsay has lived here. The Test cricketer Bill Bradley, who played for Kent, died here, and the Hampshire cricketer Donald Walker, who died serving in the RAF Volunteer Reserve, was born here. The novelist Frances Brough also died here.
